newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices lower despite cold.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices lower despite cold.

text.p: Despite cold weather blanketing much of the central U.S., millfeed prices were lower in many markets because of ample supplies of competing feeds, millfeed dealers said.

In the Southeast, dealers said ample supplies of competitively-priced corn and soybean hulls weighed on millfeed values. A Carolina source said soybean hulls were priced at $80 per ton and corn at $115 per ton, prices that were competitive with $83 he was offering for millfeeds.
Minnesota sources said feed demand was light there because heavy snow prevented farmers from getting feed to livestock and prevented them from getting to feed stores to buy more.
"If they ever get the roads open there may be a tremendous rush in business," said a Minneapolis dealer.
